definitions.explanation: The bowl-shaped opening at the top of a volcano from which lava and gases are ejected.

examples.japanese: {火口|かこう}から{煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っている。
examples.english: Smoke is rising from the crater.

examples.japanese: {火口|かこう}{付近|ふきん}への{立|た}ち{入|い}りは{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Entry to the area near the crater is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {火口|かこう}の{直径|ちょっけい}は{約|やく}300メートルある。
examples.english: The crater has a diameter of about 300 meters.

notes:
HOMOPHONE: {下降|かこう} (descent, decline) has the same reading.

ALTERNATIVE READING: Also read as ひぐち in some contexts (older/regional), but かこう is standard.

RELATED TERMS:
・{火口|かこう}湖 (crater lake)
・{火口|かこう}{原|げん} (caldera - large crater)
・{噴火口|ふんかこう} (volcanic crater - synonym)
・{火山|かざん} (volcano)
・{溶岩|ようがん} (lava)
・{噴火|ふんか} (eruption)

NOTE: Japan has many active volcanoes, making this term commonly seen in news and tourism contexts.
